en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a festive street parade. In the foreground, men in traditional folk costumes march while waving their hats. Behind them walks a large group of women dressed in similar traditional attire with pleated skirts and headscarves. One man holds a tall sign and a flagpole. The background shows a crowd of onlookers and modernist buildings with large awnings and balconies. The photo looks like a mid‑20th‑century folk or civic celebration.
